text: Hello. I want an apple, please. I want a banana and juice, please. Here you are. Thank you. Project steps Choose one snack: an apple, a banana, an orange, a sandwich, or a cookie. Choose one drink: water, milk, or juice. Make a simple snack order card. Practice the line: I want ____ and ____, please. Say the role-play with a helper: Hello. / I want ____ and ____, please. / Here you are. / Thank you. Portfolio evidence: photo of snack order card + short speaking recording of the role-play
